Hi Alex + Priya — great to hear you want to try a lighter configuration. Quick answers up front, details below:

- Yes, we can spin up a 30-day Microbundle trial (1 seat + 50k token pool) with quantized model access.
- Proration: we credit the remaining portion of the active month toward the new plan; if you downgrade mid-cycle we issue a prorated credit applied next invoice.
- Trial discount: we can offer a 25% trial discount on the Microbundle usage for the 30-day pilot.
- Rollback: immediate rollback to Compact is supported; we keep model/version pins and logs for 30 days to simplify restoration.

Action items I can own: create microbundle trial order, drop in a short SOW, and add 30-day log retention to the pilot. Ben will follow on any commercial terms. Evelyn will handle onboarding and runbook for the pilot.

Ben, can you confirm the discount/contract language we should use for a 30-day pilot, and Priya — any procurement constraints we should know about (POs, Net terms)?
